title: FREESURFER MNIBiasCorrection

in_file.desc: input volume. Input can be any format accepted by mri_convert.

iterations.desc: Number of iterations to run nu_correct. Default is 4. This is the number of times that nu_correct is repeated (ie, using the output from the previous run as the input for the next). This is different than the -iterations option to nu_correct.

mask.desc: brainmask volume. Input can be any format accepted by mri_convert.

no_rescale.desc: do not rescale so that global mean of output == input global mean

out_file.desc: output volume. Output can be any format accepted by mri_convert. If the output format is COR, then the directory must exist.

protocol_iterations.desc: Passes Np as argument of the -iterations flag of nu_correct. This is different than the --n flag above. Default is not to pass nu_correct the -iterations flag.

shrink.desc: Shrink parameter for finer sampling (default is 4)

stop.desc: Convergence threshold below which iteration stops (suggest 0.01 to 0.0001)

transform.desc: tal.xfm. Use mri_make_uchar instead of conforming

description: Wrapper for nu_correct, a program from the Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI)
